scope: Waterside placement contracts consumed by the blueprint generators (AdaptiveSupportsSpec, WaterDepthWorkCellsSpec, MatterBelow) and by export_industrial_models.py (#SupportSegment/#SupportFoot template nodes). Local block coordinates, BaseZ not added.

FishHatchery.landCells: Only the door cell (1,0,1) needs ground or a stackable below (supports.groundCells); it is also the placement cursor cell (CustomPivot). The other four bank-row cells may step down over a lower shore or water, each carried by an adaptive bank post (supports.bankColumns). A flipped hatchery has the mirrored bank cell (3,0) under the cursor (native pivots are not flipped), so on an uneven bank the flipped preview takes that cell's height.

supports.reason: Four piles under the 5x5 deck (2026-11-01 second shrink pass; four under the 7x7 deck, nine under the 8x8 deck with perimeter docks before): two under the headhouse deck (x 0 and 2 at y 2), one under the pump canopy deck (x 4, y 2) and one under the centre dock between the pens (y 4). Never in a pen. Column tops are the submerged layer 0 directly below the bank-height deck. Layer 0 is occupied by the deck, so the bed is at least one layer below the bank; the piles reach it at any depth up to six layers, like the native Deep Water Pump intake.
supports.bankReason: Natural shores are rarely straight across the whole bank row: requiring every bank-row cell on ground at bank height left the Lakes map without a site whose pens reach the water. Bank posts stand under each bank apron except the door cell, top at the terrain row z=0; on a level bank they find the bed at depth 0 and show nothing, so straight-bank placements are unchanged.

workCells.reason: Back row of both 2x2 nursery pens (y 4; the pens moved from y 4..7 to y 3..5 in the 2026-11-01 shrink, and the first cell from (1,5,0) to (1,4,0), the same pen column). The first cell is the probe and contamination sample. MinDepth 0.2 / hysteresis 0.05 is the native SwimmingPool rule the hatchery used before: the water surface must stand at least 0.2 above the pen cell's own floor (bank - 0.8), so the cages are actually wet, whatever the bed depth. MaxDepth limits the column's water from its riverbed: 7.0 is one metre beyond the deepest bed the piles can reach, so it trips only when the pens are drowned or sit over a pit deeper than any pile.

FisheryWorks.landCells: Every z=0 block except the waterside flume wing stays GroundOrStackable: the ground door, entrance, hall, undercroft and cell (1,0) under the crane mast.

supports.reason: Only the native wheel and its two basins (x 0-1, y 0-4; second shrink pass 2026-11-01, was x 9-10) may step out over a lower bank or water. Cell (1,0) stays on ground because the crane mast stands on it at z=0. Piles stand directly below the basin floors (column top z=-1); on flat ground they find the bed at depth 0 and show nothing, so existing land placements are unchanged.

FisheryWorks.workCellsReason: The Fishery draws Water through its reservoir and pipe port. It has no site water requirement; adding one would newly block every existing land placement.
